theme: Inherits from app (Light/Dark mode support). Incorporates existing dark blue header context.

typography.primary_font: System Arabic sans-serif (e.g., Cairo, Tajawal, IBM Plex Sans Arabic).

hierarchy.filter_group: text-sm font-semibold text-textMuted uppercase tracking-wider mb-2
hierarchy.badge_text: text-[10px] md:text-xs font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full

grids.page_layout: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 items-start (RTL optimized)
grids.sidebar: lg:col-span-3 lg:col-start-10 flex flex-col gap-6 sticky top-4 max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar
grids.cards_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 2xl:grid-cols-3 gap-3 md:gap-4 auto-rows-max

layouts.overall: Bento-inspired Dashboard layout adapted for RTL. A dedicated Filter Sidebar on the right (logical start in RTL) and a High-Density Grid of permission cards on the left.
layouts.sidebar_structure: Search Bar (sticky top) -> Operation Types (Wrap flex chips) -> Permission Groups (Vertical dense list of buttons with right-aligned counts).
layouts.card_structure: Flex column, p-4, rounded-xl, 1px subtle border. Top row: Arabic title (flex-grow) + Sensitivity Badge. Bottom row: ltr-enforced mono API path block + subtle background icon.

visual_enhancers.borders: Use nested radii (e.g. rounded-2xl for containers, rounded-xl for cards, rounded-md for inner badges).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use shadow-sm on cards only on hover. Rely on 1px borders (border-border) for definition.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Optional for the sticky search bar in the sidebar: backdrop-blur-md bg-background/80.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use lucide-react or Ionicons. Large, extremely subtle (opacity-5) icon in the absolute bottom-left (RTL) of the card to represent the operation type.

motion.list_entrance: Staggered fade-in for cards (optional, if framer-motion is used, otherwise standard CSS transition).

accessibility.rtl_support: Ensure all layout classes respect RTL. Use standard Tailwind standard classes with dir='rtl' on parent, or logical properties (ms-, me-, ps-, pe-, text-start, text-end).
accessibility.api_path_ltr: CRITICAL: The API path (e.g., 'GET /api/v1/users') MUST be forced into LTR direction (`dir="ltr" text-left`) even within the RTL card, otherwise slashes and text render incorrectly.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure warning/danger text colors meet 4.5:1 ratio against their 10% opacity backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: Redesign AdvPermissionsBrowser.js into a Sidebar + Card Grid layout.
Implement the right-side (RTL) Filter Sidebar containing Search, Operation filters, and Group filters.
Do NOT use a cramped horizontal scroll strip for 30 groups. Use a vertical list in the sidebar with notification-style count bubbles.
Implement the Permission Card design: Flat, distinct, readable. Ensure the Arabic label is prominent.
Force the API path string into LTR using `<div dir="ltr" className="text-left font-mono text-xs text-textMuted">`.
Use color-coded badges for sensitivity (Low=Green, Medium=Orange, High/Critical=Red).

Optimize for performance: If rendering up to 900 items is slow, ensure standard React memoization on the cards, or limit initial render via pagination/virtualization if feasible (though 200 items in a CSS grid is generally performant without virtual lists).
Use existing color tokens (primary, success, warning, danger, border, card, text, textMuted) directly in className if they are configured in tailwind.config.js, or map them correctly.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and 1px crisp borders.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or rounded-lg) with interaction animations & relevant colors.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Use generous spacing (`gap-4`, `p-4`, `p-6`). Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use placeholder URLs or AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 for icons.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).
